# Calculate DE genes between conditions
```{r}
object <- obj.10x

Idents(object) <- "condition"
de <- FindMarkers(object, ident.1 = "nicm", ident.2 = "donor", logfc.threshold = 0.05)         # Run FindMarkers
de <- de %>% filter(!grepl("^MT-", rownames(de)))                                              # Remove mitochondrial genes
write.csv(de, "/Users/haewonshin/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-WashingtonUniversityinSt.Louis/obsidian/my_vault/lab/experiments/01_icell_10x_paper_revisions/processed/de_10x_nicm-vs-donor_no-mito.csv")
```

# Volcano plot of DEGs
```{r}
de <- read.csv("/Users/haewonshin/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-WashingtonUniversityinSt.Louis/obsidian/my_vault/lab/experiments/01_icell_10x_paper_revisions/processed/de_icell_nicm-vs-donor_no-mito.csv", row.names = 1)

#de <- read.csv("/Volumes/klavine/Active/Haewon/icell_10x_comparison_nicm_donor/icell_10x_paper/pseudobulk/marker_tables/icell myeloid.csv", row.names = 1)

# Add significance labels based on log2foldchange
de$group <- "NS"
de$group[de$p_val_adj < 0.05 & de$avg_log2FC > 1] <- "Up"
de$group[de$p_val_adj < 0.05 & de$avg_log2FC < -1] <- "Down"

# for 10X adjust the p values
de$p_val_adj[de$p_val_adj == 0] <- 1e-300
de$log10padj <- -log10(de$p_val_adj)
de$log10padj_cap <- pmin(de$log10padj, 50)


sig <- subset(de, p_val_adj < 0.05)                                               # find significant entries
sig$score <- abs(sig$avg_log2FC)                                                  # create significance score

top.up <- sig[sig$avg_log2FC > 0, ]                                               # top upregulated genes
top.up <- top.up[order(top.up$score, decreasing = TRUE), ][1:5, ]                

top.down <- sig[sig$avg_log2FC < 0, ]                                             # top downregulated genes
top.down <- top.down[order(top.down$score, decreasing = TRUE), ][1:5, ]

top <- rbind(top.up, top.down)                                                    # combine

p3 <- ggplot(de, aes(avg_log2FC, log10padj_cap, color = group)) +                 # volcano plot
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-5, 5), ylim = c(0, 55)) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top,
    aes(label = rownames(top)),
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Up" = "red",
    "Down" = "blue",
    "NS" = "gray"
  )) +
  theme_classic()

ggsave(
   "/Users/haewonshin/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-WashingtonUniversityinSt.Louis/obsidian/my_vault/lab/experiments/01_icell_10x_paper_revisions/figures/de_icell_volcano.pdf",
  plot = p3,
  width = 5,
  height = 4,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```

# Heatmap of most upregulated DE genes
```{r}
de <- read.csv("/Volumes/klavine/Active/Haewon/icell_10x_comparison_nicm_donor/icell_10x_paper/pseudobulk/marker_tables/10x cm.csv", row.names = 1)
obj <- obj.10x

genes <- de %>%
  subset(abs(avg_log2FC) > 1.0 & p_val_adj < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC))

gene.list <- rownames(genes)

# average expression by condition
avg <- AverageExpression(
  obj,
  features = gene.list,
  group.by = "condition",
  assays = "SCT"
)$SCT
 
mat <- t(avg)                               # transpose so rows = condition, columns = genes
mat <- scale(mat)                           # scale by gene

# heatmap
p4 <- pheatmap(
  mat,
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  border_color = "gray",
  fontsize_row = 10,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  angle_col = 45,
  main = "DE Between NICM and Donor Cardiomyocytes"
)

ggsave(
   "/Users/haewonshin/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-WashingtonUniversityinSt.Louis/obsidian/my_vault/lab/experiments/01_icell_10x_paper_revisions/figures/de_10x_cardiomyocytes_heatmap.pdf",
  plot = p4,
  width = 8,
  height = 5,
  device = cairo_pdf
)
```


# Biotype breakdown of DE genes
```{r}
# Icell
gene_info <- read.table(file = "/Volumes/klavine/Active/Haewon/nicm_donor/samples_icell/D1118/analyze/gene_info.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE) # get gene info
# start with icell DE genes
de_sig <- markers.icell[markers.icell$p_val_adj < 0.05, ]
de_sig <- gene_info[gene_info$Gene_Name %in% rownames(de_sig), ]
de_sig <- de_sig[!duplicated(de_sig$Gene_Name), ]
biotype.ct <- de_sig %>% dplyr::count(Gene_Biotype)
biotype.ct <- biotype.ct[order(-biotype.ct$n), ]

palette <- c(
  "#F4A300", # Golden Yellow - antisense
  "#FFD700", # Golden - bidirectional promoter
  "#1F77B4", # Vibrant Blue - lincrna
  "#377EB8", # Deep Blue - macro_lncRNA
  "#4B9CD3", # Sky Blue - miscRNA
  "#6B8E23", # Olive Green - pseudogene
  "#E78AC3", # Pink - processed transript
  "#FF6F61", # Soft Coral - protein coding
  "#FF9E9D", # Pastel Peach - sense intronic
  "#4DAF4A", # Green - sense_overlapping
  "#2E8B57", # Sea Green - snRNA
  "#9E9AC7", # Lavender Gray - TEC
  "#FF7F00",  # Dark Orange - transcribed processed pseudogene
  "#A6D854", # Lime Green - unitary
  "#A1D6E1",  # Soft Cyan - other
  "#D16F8D" # Muted Rose - unprocessed
)

pie <- ggplot(biotype.ct, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = Gene_Biotype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +                             
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.text = element_text(size = 36),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(family = "ssp")
    )

ggsave("/Users/haewonshin/Desktop/ICELL 10X paper/Figures_from_R/DEG/icell_de_biotypes.png", plot = pie, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# Pseudobulk plot
```{r}
pseudo.icell <- AggregateExpression(icell, assays = "RNA", slot = "counts", return.seurat = T, group.by = c("sample", "condition", "cell_type"))

# Raw counts matrix
counts <- GetAssayData(pseudo.icell, slot = "counts")

# Cell (pseudobulk sample) names look like: "sample_condition_celltype"
cell_names <- colnames(counts)

# Parse metadata from cell names
meta <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, strsplit(cell_names, "_")))
colnames(meta) <- c("sample", "condition", "cell_type")
meta$group <- cell_names
rownames(meta) <- cell_names
```
```{r}
library(DESeq2)

results_list <- list()

for (ct in unique(meta$cell_type)) {
  message("Running DE for cell type: ", ct)
  
  keep_cells <- meta$cell_type == ct
  counts_ct <- counts[, keep_cells]
  meta_ct <- meta[keep_cells, ]

  # Skip if < 2 samples per condition
  if (length(unique(meta_ct$condition)) < 2 || min(table(meta_ct$condition)) < 2) next

  dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
    countData = counts_ct,
    colData = meta_ct,
    design = ~ condition
  )

  # Filter low counts
  keep_genes <- rowSums(counts(dds)) > 10
  dds <- dds[keep_genes, ]

  dds <- DESeq(dds)
  res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "nicm", "donor"))
  
  res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
  res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)
  res_df$cell_type <- ct

  results_list[[ct]] <- res_df
}
```
```{r}
# Merge all DE results
pseudobulk_de <- do.call(rbind, results_list)
pseudobulk_de$significance_fc <- ifelse(abs(pseudobulk_de$log2FoldChange) > 0.5, "FC > 0.5", "FC ≤ 0.5")
pseudobulk_de <- subset(pseudobulk_de, cell_type != "Proliferating")

p <- ggplot(pseudobulk_de, aes(x = cell_type, y = log2FoldChange, color = significance_fc)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.3, alpha = 0.8, size = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FC > 0.5" = "red", "FC ≤ 0.5" = "gray")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-10, 10)) +
  theme_classic() +  # ← USE THIS INSTEAD
  labs(
    y = expression(log[2]*"FC"),
    x = NULL,
    color = "Log2 FC"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 40),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 40),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 32),
    legend.position = "none",
    text = element_text(family = "ssp")
  )


ggsave("/Users/personal/Desktop/ICELL 10X paper/Figures with introns/icell_pseudobulk_new.png", plot = p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

# Dot plot of canonical genes
```{r}
Idents(icell) <- "annot_fig"
celltypes <- levels(Idents(icell))
celltypes <- celltypes[celltypes != "Proliferating"]
sorted <- sort(celltypes)
idents <- as.character(Idents(icell))
keep <- idents %in% sorted
icell <- subset(icell, cells = WhichCells(icell)[keep])
icell <- SetIdent(icell, value = factor(Idents(icell), levels = sorted))
features = c("CD3E", "RGS5", "FCGR3A", "KIT", "C1QA", "CCL21", "DCN", "VWF", "LEPR", "RYR2")

dot <- DotPlot(icell, features = features) + 
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "ssp"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 40),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 40),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 40),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 40),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 30),    # smaller legend text
    legend.title = element_text(size = 30)
  )
ggsave("/Users/haewonshin/Desktop/ICELL 10X paper/Figures_from_R/DEG/icell_canonical_genes.png", plot = dot, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
```{r}
Idents(x) <- "annot_fig"

sorted <- sort(celltypes)

x <- SetIdent(x, value = factor(Idents(x), levels = sorted))
features = c("CD3E", "RGS5", "FCGR3A", "KIT", "C1QA", "CCL21", "DCN", "VWF", "LEPR", "RYR2")
```

# Venn diagram
```{r}
# Upregulated genes
up_icell <- markers.icell %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.25) %>%
  pull(gene)

up_10x <- markers.10x %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.25) %>%
  pull(gene)

# Downregulated genes
down_icell <- markers.icell %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < -0.25) %>%
  pull(gene)

down_10x <- markers.10x %>%
  filter(p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC < -0.25) %>%
  pull(gene)



p1 <- ggvenn(
  list(
    "ICELL" = up_icell,
    "10X" = up_10x
  ),
  fill_color = c("tomato", "orange"),
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  set_name_size = 20,
  text_size = 20,
  show_percentage = FALSE
) + 
  theme(text = element_text(family = "ssp"))

p2 <- ggvenn(
  list(
    "ICELL" = down_icell,
    "10X" = down_10x
  ),
  fill_color = c("steelblue", "skyblue"),
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  set_name_size = 20,
  text_size = 20,
  show_percentage = FALSE
) + 
  theme(text = element_text(family = "ssp"))

ggsave("./figures/venn_upregulated.png", plot = p1, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("./figures/venn_downregulated.png", plot = p2, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

# Venn diagrams in pdf form
```{r}
library(ggvenn)

# Create list with counts encoded as elements
set1 <- paste0("A", 1:52)
shared <- paste0("S", 1:43)
set2_unique <- paste0("B", 1:74)

list_data <- list(
  Set1 = c(set1, shared),
  Set2 = c(set2_unique, shared)
)

# Plot
v <- ggvenn(
  list_data,
  fill_color = c("pink", "purple"),
  stroke_size = 0.5,
  show_percentage = FALSE,
  set_name_size = 0
)
```
